services.title: BASIC CAR WASH
services.whatItDoes: Exterior wash + basic vacuuming + interior plastic dressing. Simple cleaning for regular maintenance.

services.title: PREMIUM WASH & DETAILING
services.whatItDoes: Deep cleaning with two-step washing: foam/touchless pre-wash + contact wash to remove heavy dirt and contamination. Includes interior detailing, leather cleaning, plastic coating/dressing, glass cleaning & glass coating, plus removal of visible contamination such as salt marks, tar, stains and other deposits.

services.title: INTERIOR DETAILING (ONLY)
services.whatItDoes: Deep cleaning of seats, carpets, dashboard, plastics, doors and other interior surfaces, removing dirt, stains and buildup.

services.title: WAXING
services.whatItDoes: Adds a smooth, glossy finish and a temporary protective layer to the paint.

services.title: PAINT CORRECTION
services.whatItDoes: Machine polishing that removes/reduces swirl marks, light scratches, oxidation and paint imperfections, restoring gloss and clarity.

services.title: CERAMIC COATING (4 YEARS)
services.whatItDoes: A durable protective coating that bonds to the paint, providing gloss, hydrophobic water-beading and protection against environmental contamination.

services.title: GRAPHENE COATING (5 YEARS)
services.whatItDoes: Advanced coating protection designed to provide high gloss, water repellency and a durable protective layer over the paint.

services.title: PPF (PAINT PROTECTION FILM)
services.whatItDoes: A transparent protective film applied to the paint to help protect against stone chips, scratches, road debris and minor impacts.

services.title: ADD-ON SERVICES
services.whatItDoes: Extra care for specific parts of your vehicle.

services.title: MEMBERSHIP PACKAGES
services.whatItDoes: More Care. More Value. Always a shiny ride!
